p.title: v59.97 a lapsed static review window no longer stops every data release
p.symptom: From 2026-12-01 the static-db-expiry gate would have failed (conf-gtc-dc schedule exhausted for more than 14 days), and because the gate runs in the data-refresh publish step every market, news and brief release would have stopped until someone edited the calendar; more schedules lapse through December and the 90-day universe limit on 2027-01-11.
p.root_cause: Three wall-clock judgements (universe replaceAfterDays, exhausted official schedule, events past their interest window) were hard failures in a gate that belongs to the publish path, although the screen already degrades a lapsed value to expired and review workflows exist to raise it.
p.fix: scripts/ci-static-db-expiry-check.mjs reports the three lapsed-window judgements as warnings; structural checks (mirror counts, provenance, review report fixtures, theme map) still fail.
p.violated_rule: P1542: a data problem is shown honestly on screen and must not stop shipping.
p.prevention: A clock replay of the gate at 2026-12-01, 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-15 exits 0 with the warnings printed; the same replay on the old gate exits 1.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-static-db-expiry-check.mjs exits 0 today; pinned-clock replays exit 0 with warnings.

changelog: **A lapsed calendar no longer stops data releases ({P}):** the static-database expiry gate warns on lapsed review windows instead of failing the publish step (it would have blocked every release from 2026-12-01).
note: v59.97: static-db expiry windows warn instead of blocking publishes
